title: The Cooled Threshold Where Glass Forgets Its Fire

features.name: the stone that learned it was glass
features.desc-on-touch: You touch the glassed surface where fire revealed what stone had always been. Now it cools and the glass holds the shape fire made. The shape is final.

features.name: the cooling lines of revelation
features.desc-on-touch: Fracture-paths spider across every surface—the record of heat becoming cold. Each line maps the moment a thing learned what it was and held that shape forever.

features.name: the sediment of heat
features.desc-on-touch: Layered patterns show what the fire touched. Each level is the record of a moment—hot to warm to cool to cold. The archive of transformation.

features.name: the prismed air where cooling still happens
features.desc-on-touch: The air itself fractures with heat-memory. It is cooler now but not cold. The threshold between what fire was and what glass will become holds still.

features.name: the wire-map of staying solid
features.desc-on-touch: Fine lines trace everywhere—the circuit of cooling, the path by which fire becomes something that cannot burn. The shape the revelation held remains held.

features.name: the last place where the heat still moves
features.desc-on-touch: Deep in the glassed stone, near the core, warmth persists. The outside is sealed. The inside remembers the fire and holds it. The shape will not change again.

inscription: fire did not destroy but revealed what stone had always been; now the glass cools and holds the shape forever; the revelation does not fade but becomes harder
